-- upvalues, nested closures and recursion
local function makeCounter(start, step)
	local value = start
	return function()
		value += step
		return value
	end, function()
		value = start
	end
end

local next, reset = makeCounter(10, 5)
print(next(), next())
reset()
print(next())

local function memoize(fn)
	local cache = {}
	return function(n)
		local hit = cache[n]
		if hit == nil then
			hit = fn(n)
			cache[n] = hit
		end
		return hit
	end
end

local fib
fib = memoize(function(n)
	if n < 2 then
		return n
	end
	return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
end)
print(fib(40))

local handlers = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
	handlers[i] = function(x)
		return x * i
	end
end
print(handlers[2](21))

-- branches and every loop kind
local function classify(n)
	if n < 0 then
		return "negative"
	elseif n == 0 then
		return "zero"
	elseif n % 2 == 0 then
		return "even"
	else
		return "odd"
	end
end

local function sumUntil(limit)
	local total, i = 0, 1
	while total < limit do
		total += i
		i += 1
	end
	return total, i
end

local function firstPrimeAfter(n)
	local candidate = n
	repeat
		candidate += 1
		local prime = candidate > 1
		for d = 2, math.floor(math.sqrt(candidate)) do
			if candidate % d == 0 then
				prime = false
				break
			end
		end
	until prime
	return candidate
end

local counts = {}
for _, word in ipairs({ "a", "b", "a", "c", "b", "a" }) do
	if word == "c" then
		continue
	end
	counts[word] = (counts[word] or 0) + 1
end

for key, value in pairs(counts) do
	print(key, value, classify(value))
end

for i = 10, 1, -3 do
	print(i, sumUntil(i), firstPrimeAfter(i))
end

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("bag", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if self.n > 0 then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
print("found", found)

-- nested loops over the same table, the inner one reading the outer's variables
local grid = { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }
local sum = 0
for r, row in grid do
	for c, cell in row do
		sum += cell * r * c
	end
end
print("grid", sum)

-- a table changed between loops is walked as it is now
local growing = { 1 }
for round = 1, 3 do
	local seen = 0
	for _ in growing do
		seen += 1
	end
	growing[#growing + 1] = round
	print("round", round, seen)
end

--!strict
-- An inventory with stacking, weight limits and a sorted report.

local Inventory = {}
Inventory.__index = Inventory

local ITEMS = {
	sword = { weight = 8, stack = 1, value = 120 },
	potion = { weight = 1, stack = 10, value = 25 },
	arrow = { weight = 0.1, stack = 64, value = 1 },
	shield = { weight = 12, stack = 1, value = 90 },
}

function Inventory.new(capacity)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Inventory)
	self.capacity = capacity
	self.slots = {}
	self.weight = 0
	return self
end

local function round(n, places)
	local scale = 10 ^ places
	return math.floor(n * scale + 0.5) / scale
end

function Inventory:add(name, count)
	local info = ITEMS[name]
	if not info then
		return false, `unknown item {name}`
	end
	if self.weight + info.weight * count > self.capacity then
		return false, `too heavy: {round(self.weight + info.weight * count, 1)} > {self.capacity}`
	end
	local left = count
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		if slot.name == name and slot.count < info.stack then
			local moved = math.min(info.stack - slot.count, left)
			slot.count += moved
			left -= moved
			if left == 0 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	while left > 0 do
		local moved = math.min(info.stack, left)
		table.insert(self.slots, { name = name, count = moved })
		left -= moved
	end
	self.weight += info.weight * count
	return true
end

function Inventory:remove(name, count)
	for i = #self.slots, 1, -1 do
		local slot = self.slots[i]
		if slot.name ~= name then
			continue
		end
		local taken = math.min(slot.count, count)
		slot.count -= taken
		count -= taken
		self.weight -= ITEMS[name].weight * taken
		if slot.count == 0 then
			table.remove(self.slots, i)
		end
		if count == 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return count == 0
end

function Inventory:report()
	local totals = {}
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		totals[slot.name] = (totals[slot.name] or 0) + slot.count
	end
	local names = {}
	for name in totals do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names, function(a, b)
		return ITEMS[a].value * totals[a] > ITEMS[b].value * totals[b]
	end)
	local lines = {}
	for rank, name in names do
		lines[rank] = `{rank}. {name} x{totals[name]} ({ITEMS[name].value * totals[name]}g)`
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n"), round(self.weight, 2)
end

local bag = Inventory.new(40)
print(bag:add("arrow", 150))
print(bag:add("potion", 12))
print(bag:add("sword", 1))
print(bag:add("shield", 3))
print(bag:add("wand", 1))
print(bag:remove("arrow", 70), bag:remove("potion", 20))
print(bag:report())

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- a guard whose branches both fall through, around a comparison with a constant on the left
local count = 0
for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end
print("count", count)

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end

	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- table constructors: positional entries overwrite earlier [1] =, a call or ... last expands but
-- anywhere else gives one value, nil holes, and keys that need brackets
local function two()
	return "a", "b"
end
local function show(t, n)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		out[i] = tostring(t[i])
	end
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

print(show({ [1] = "x", "y" }, 2))
print(show({ "y", [1] = "x" }, 2))
print(show({ two() }, 3), show({ two(), "c" }, 3), show({ (two()) }, 3), show({ two(), two() }, 4))
print(show({ nil, 2, nil, 4 }, 4), select("#", table.unpack({ 1, nil, 3 }, 1, 3)))

local function pack(...)
	return { ... }, { n = select("#", ...), ... }, { ..., "last" }
end
local a, b, c = pack(1, nil, 3)
print(show(a, 3), b.n, show(b, 3), show(c, 3))

local k = "dyn"
local t = {
	plain = 1,
	["with space"] = 2,
	["end"] = 3,
	[k] = 4,
	[k .. "2"] = 5,
	[10] = 6,
	[-1] = 7,
	[1.5] = 8,
	[true] = 9,
	nested = { deep = { deeper = { 10 } } },
	fn = function(self)
		return self.plain
	end,
	"pos1",
	"pos2",
}
print(t.plain, t["with space"], t["end"], t.dyn, t.dyn2, t[10], t[-1], t[1.5], t[true])
print(t.nested.deep.deeper[1], t:fn(), t[1], t[2], #t)

-- the same key twice: the later one wins
local dup = { x = 1, x = 2, [2] = "a", "b", "c" }
print(dup.x, dup[1], dup[2])

-- assignment chains through fresh tables
local root = {}
root.a = {}
root.a.b = {}
root.a.b.c = "set"
root["a"]["b"].d = root.a.b.c .. "!"
print(root.a.b.c, root.a.b.d)

-- table constructors: positional entries overwrite earlier [1] =, a call or ... last expands but
-- anywhere else gives one value, nil holes, and keys that need brackets
local function two()
	return "a", "b"
end
local function show(t, n)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		out[i] = tostring(t[i])
	end
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

print(show({ [1] = "x", "y" }, 2))
print(show({ "y", [1] = "x" }, 2))
print(show({ two() }, 3), show({ two(), "c" }, 3), show({ (two()) }, 3), show({ two(), two() }, 4))
print(show({ nil, 2, nil, 4 }, 4), select("#", table.unpack({ 1, nil, 3 }, 1, 3)))

local function pack(...)
	return { ... }, { n = select("#", ...), ... }, { ..., "last" }
end
local a, b, c = pack(1, nil, 3)
print(show(a, 3), b.n, show(b, 3), show(c, 3))

local k = "dyn"
local t = {
	plain = 1,
	["with space"] = 2,
	["end"] = 3,
	[k] = 4,
	[k .. "2"] = 5,
	[10] = 6,
	[-1] = 7,
	[1.5] = 8,
	[true] = 9,
	nested = { deep = { deeper = { 10 } } },
	fn = function(self)
		return self.plain
	end,
	"pos1",
	"pos2",
}

print(t.nested.deep.deeper[1], t:fn(), t[1], t[2], #t)

root.a.b = {}

-- rosetta mutant mut1-94 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, flip, wrap do
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

do
function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left  <  self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

end
local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-99 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, flip, wrap do, delete
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

do
function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left  <  self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

end
local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end
